bio: This old crêperie in Morgat, once a sardine and tuna fishing port and part of Crozon, has been given a new lease of life by a young couple. In their convivial restaurant with an open kitchen, the short seasonal menu on the slate board sets the tone: red mullet and a rich, full-flavoured soup, pollock with butternut French toast, or peanut cream, chocolate ganache and sesame caramel. More than 100 wines are available by the glass at thirst-quenching prices: a trove of unusual combinations to look forward to!
